title: Insurer Coverage Terms Schedule for Rental Vehicle Coordination
content:
For Rental Vehicle Coordination the coverage terms that bound covered rental days are the same in every class: the grace after a vehicle-ready notice, the coverage that runs on after a total-loss notice, the longest single rental agreement, the lead time and size of an extension request, network courtesy for network-caused delay, the treatment of the excess over an insurer's daily cap, and direct billing to the insurer.

## Schedule

| Rental class | Ready-notice grace (business days) | Total-loss coverage (calendar days) | Longest rental agreement (calendar days) | Extension request lead (hours) | Most days per extension request | Network pays days lost to its own delay | Daily-cap excess is the customer's | Covered portion billed directly to the insurer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Economy Rental | 1 | 3 | 30 | 24 | 5 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Compact Rental | 1 | 3 | 30 | 24 | 5 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Intermediate Rental | 1 | 3 | 30 | 24 | 5 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Full-Size Rental | 1 | 3 | 30 | 24 | 5 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Standard SUV Rental | 1 | 3 | 30 | 24 | 5 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Minivan Rental | 1 | 3 | 30 | 24 | 5 | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Footnotes to the schedule

1. Ready-notice grace: the business days after the vehicle-ready notice date through which rental coverage continues for pickup.
2. Total-loss coverage: the calendar days after the total-loss notice date through which rental coverage continues.
3. Longest rental agreement: the longest single rental agreement before it is renewed at the branch, in calendar days.
4. Extension request lead: the hours before the current coverage end by which an extension request must reach the insurer.
5. Most days per extension request: the most days one extension request may ask for.
6. Network pays days lost to its own delay: whether rental days lost to a delay the network caused are paid by the network.
7. Daily-cap excess: whether the part of the daily rate above the insurer's daily cap is the customer's.
8. Direct billing: whether the covered portion is billed directly to the insurer.

## Hypothetical readings

- An extension request must reach the insurer at least 24 hours before the current coverage end, whichever class is rented; a request asking for 6 days exceeds the 5 days one request may ask for, while a request for 5 days does not.
- A total-loss notice dated on a Monday leaves coverage running through the following Thursday, the third calendar day after the notice date.
